envelope.description: Signal measurements and record terminal evidence

body.title: Signal measurements and record terminal evidence
body.summary: In ReviewWorkers.acceptProgress, after a publication is accepted, signal the coordinator through the review producer's signalMeasurement for the registered owner, and when the review reaches a terminal phase record the owner's terminal evidence through recordLifecycle from that phase, never from the review verdict. Calls are fire-and-forget guarded so a coordinator failure cannot affect progress acceptance, the board update or reclaim.
acceptanceChecks: an observed review's task progress changes as publications are accepted
terminal evidence follows the owner's terminal phase (complete, failed, interrupted) and never the review verdict
coordinator failures are fire-and-forget guarded and never affect progress acceptance, the board update or reclaim
